children: Brian J. Brille, an Officer serving as Vice Chairman and Executive Vice President, reported a sale on 2026-09-17. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $30.3302 per share. The total sale amount reported was $12,132,080. After the transaction, Brille directly owns 230,303 shares and indirectly owns 500,000 shares via a family trust. The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership except to the extent of his pecuniary interest and the trust consolidated shares previously held in multiple family trusts.
